snippet.title: The Stacks, Atari 2600 - Gameplay
snippet.description:
The Stacks is platform game by Mike Mika & Kevin Wilson based on Novel by Ernest Cline - Ready Player One. RP1 Easter Egg Hunt - Contest
Played by DJ on Atari 2600 emulator - Stella (6/2012)
This was the first video game challenge in RP1 Easter Egg Hunt - Contest started in June 2012.
